comments.content: The error message arguments are swapped: it reports `Requested nodeIndex: %d, cluster size: %d` but passes `(server.clusterSize(), nodeIndex)`. Should be `(nodeIndex, server.clusterSize())`.
Typo in parameter name `mumServers` — should be `numServers`.

`images.split(",")` is called twice; the second call inside the condition is redundant and confusing. Also, when `images` is non-empty but contains a single value, `imagePeServer` is set to the split result and then `imagePeServer[0]` is used — this works, but the logic is convoluted. Consider simplifying.
`String[] imagePeServer = null;` — variable name `imagePeServer` looks like a typo (probably `imagePerServer`).

`@ConfigProperty` on fields of a class that is not a CDI bean (it's instantiated via `new` in the extension) will not be injected. These fields will always keep their default values, so `numContainer` and `images` config properties are effectively ignored. Use `Config.getXxx` (as done elsewhere in the test framework) or make this a CDI bean.

`container.getExposedPorts().get(0)` assumes the first exposed port is the DB port. For some containers (e.g. those exposing multiple ports) this may not be the DB port. Consider using `container.getMappedPort(...)` semantics or the specific DB port constant.

`getContainerInfo().getNetworkSettings().getNetworks().values().iterator().next()` picks an arbitrary network. If the container is attached to multiple networks this may return the wrong IP. Consider selecting the network by name or documenting the assumption.

`BuildToolHelper.getProjectDir(Paths.get(""))` relies on the current working directory. This is fragile when tests are run from a different directory. Consider resolving relative to a known classpath resource (as done in `ClusteredKeycloakServer.defaultImage()`).

The default constructor eagerly calls `createImage(...)` which resolves the distribution archive and may throw if it doesn't exist. Previously the image was created lazily inside `getKeycloakContainer()`. This changes behavior for callers that construct the distribution but never start it.

`copyToContainer` is a `Map<MountableFile, String>` keyed by `MountableFile`. If the same source file is copied to two different destinations, the second put will overwrite the first. Consider keying by destination path instead.

The test sleeps for a full minute and only prints URLs — it doesn't actually assert anything. This looks like a placeholder/WIP test that will slow down CI. Consider removing the sleep or converting to a real assertion before merging.
Hardcoded version `999.0.0-SNAPSHOT` instead of `${project.version}`. This will break when the project version changes.
